sources.title: simple-generation · PyPI
sources.snippet: Simple Generation Simple Generation offers a minimal interface to run text generation with HuggingFace checkpoints. The core idea is to ship many neat features out of the box, avoiding boilerplate. Simplegen is mainly for personal use and simple hardware setups (ideally, single-node single- or multi-gpu). If you are looking for production-ready inference engine consider looking elsewhere ...
